title: 3 money mistakes in your 40s you can still fix
caption:
Mistake one. Thinking it's too late to start. Even twenty years of steady investing can grow a lot.
For example, one thousand dollars in the S&P 500 in 2006 is now worth about {growth:SPY:2006-01-03}.
Mistake two. Paying for everyone else's goals before your own retirement.
Mistake three. Not knowing where your money goes each month.
comment: How old were you when you started investing? 👇
sources: S&P 500 ETF (SPY) price history, Yahoo Finance, at render time (price only, no dividends)
